subject.name: English
subject.examPattern: School-based (no CBSE board exam in Class 8; legacy CBSE scheme Circular Acad-14/2017: 80-mark written exam + 20 periodic assessment). Model mirrors the Class 9/10 CBSE paper design so students build board-exam habits early. Assumed paper: 80 marks, 14 questions (Class 9 R1 design: Reading 20, Grammar 10, Writing 20, Literature 30).
